sources.title: nemotron-3-embed-1b Model by NVIDIA | NVIDIA NIM
sources.snippet: Nemotron-3-Embed-1B is a versatile text embedding model developed by NVIDIA and optimized for retrieval and semantic similarity tasks. It provides strong multilingual and cross-lingual retrieval capabilities and is designed to serve as a foundational component in text-based Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems.

sources.title: nemotron-3-embed-1b Model by NVIDIA | NVIDIA NIM
sources.snippet: nvidia/nemotron-3-embed-1b operates in `passage` or `query` mode, and thus requires the `input_type` parameter. `passage` is used when generating embeddings during indexing. `query` is used when generating embeddings during querying.

sources.title: Nemotron 3 Embed 1B BF16 - inferbase.ai
sources.snippet: Nemotron 3 Embed 1B BF16 is a text embedding model built by NVIDIA, optimized for retrieval and semantic similarity tasks. It is designed as a foundational component for multilingual Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems, with strong multilingual and cross-lingual retrieval capabilities evaluated across 34 languages.
